robustness.note: The published headline is the MW-weighted average of the priced deals (reproducible from the rows below). To keep ONE flagged row from moving it, we publish two cross-checks and a confidence band. See /api/v1/nppi for the live computation and /intelligence/methodology for the formula.
robustness.method: MW-weighted average of priced deals (mwh_low/mwh_high midpoints).
robustness.concentration_flag: Uncapped, Meta carries ~53% of headline weight and the 2026-01-09 Meta row alone ~37%. With a 20% per-counterparty / per-date cap the headline is $100; excluding the one externally-unverified row it is $98. The number does not depend on any single row — all three lenses bracket $97–$100.
